prompt:
Research the fee OpenRouter charges when buying credits (card and crypto), and any fee on bring-your-own-key usage. Cite OpenRouter's own documentation or FAQ and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on OpenRouter's official documentation, here are the fees for purchasing credits and using bring-your-own-keys (BYOK).

**Credit Purchase Fees:**
- For non-cryptocurrency payments (e.g., credit card), OpenRouter charges a fee of 5.5% of the order amount, with a minimum fee of $0.80.
- For cryptocurrency payments (USDC), OpenRouter charges a flat fee of 5.0%, with no minimum fee.

**BYOK Usage Fee:**
- When using your own provider keys (BYOK), there is a usage-based fee. OpenRouter offers a monthly free allowance. Usage beyond this allowance incurs a fee of 5% of what the same model and provider would normally cost if using OpenRouter credits. This fee is deducted from your OpenRouter credit balance.

Below are the specific sources and quotes that support these claims.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "OpenRouter charges a 5.5% ($0.80 minimum) fee when you purchase credits... Crypto payments are charged a fee of 5%." | CLAIM: Credit card purchases have a 5.5% fee ($0.80 min); crypto purchases have a 5% fee.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/simplifying-our-platform-fee/ | QUOTE: "Non-crypto payments: 5.5% of the order amount, with a minimum fee of $0.80" | CLAIM: Confirms the fee structure for non-crypto payments.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/simplifying-our-platform-fee/ | QUOTE: "Crypto payments: 5.0% flat, no minimum fee" | CLAIM: Confirms the fee structure for crypto payments.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "BYOK has a plan-dependent free allowance measured by list-price inference cost, not request count... Usage above the allowance has a fee of 5% of what the same model and provider would normally cost on OpenRouter." | CLAIM: BYOK usage beyond the free allowance incurs a 5% fee based on OpenRouter's list price.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/byok | QUOTE: "The cost of using custom provider keys on OpenRouter is 5% of what the same model/provider would cost normally on OpenRouter and will be deducted from your OpenRouter credits." | CLAIM: Confirms the 5% BYOK usage fee.
